name: Multimodal Embeddings (OpenAI-compatible)
description: Memory embedding provider for any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings server, with image and audio indexing for models that support it (e.g. EmbeddingGemma 2 on llama.cpp).

models.description: Per-model settings, keyed by the model id sent to the server. Use "*" for a default.

modalities.description: Media this model can embed in the same space as text. Omit for a text-only model.

mediaFormat.description: Request shape for media inputs. content-parts: llama.cpp / OpenRouter {content:[...]} objects.

preset.description: Built-in prompt prefixes. Defaults to embeddinggemma for model ids containing 'embeddinggemma', otherwise none.

mediaLabel.description: Whether to send memory's 'Image file: <path>' label with media. omit embeds the media alone.

dimensions.description: Expected vector size; vectors are checked against it.

convertMedia.description: Convert media the server cannot decode (webp, heic, ogg, opus, m4a, ...) with ffmpeg before sending. Default true.

ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg binary. Default: ffmpeg on PATH.
